text:
rachel-sales: Heads up — BeaconHealth just escalated: multiple dashboard calls hit p95 ~1.8s after last runtime deploy. They say user facing slowdown and will push back on SLA. SUP-4532 created.

tina-support: cc @sam-prod @jin-runtime filing details in SUP-4532, attaching their sample traces and a CSV of request ids.

sam-prod: Thanks — can you paste the top span from their trace? we need to know if it's model time or routing.

tina-support: trace link: https://internal.redwood/trace/ab12cd, top span shows long wait at "router::select_shard" and downstream "serve::generate" p95 ~1.2s

jin-runtime: I looked at the trace. Looks like a queuing/backpressure issue on the small-pool instances for that tenant. We had a config tweak in last deploy that reduced max-concurrency on legacy pools.

maria-eng-oncall: Confirmed on our side: alerts for a >30% increase in serve latency for BeaconHealth route between 15:22–15:35 UTC. Metric: route.beaconhealth.p95_tokens = 1.8s. See INC-3421.

eli-eng-platform: If it's config-related we can hotfix by reverting the concurrency cap or bumping pool size. But need product decision: is this customer urgent enough to alter global defaults? Q3 roadmap includes batching/cache work that would reduce this class of incidents.

sam-prod: Priority: high. BeaconHealth is on a paid Dedicated-ish contract with latency clause. We should treat as P1 for triage, but for long-term we need a spec: what product changes would prevent repeat? put on backlog as "route-specific throttles + auto-burst"?

jin-runtime: Short-term mitigation: revert the deploy config that lowered concurrency (deploy id: canary-2026-07-18-3). I can push a rollback; that'll buy us time. Medium-term: add per-tenant autoscale and smarter routing based on latency SLO.

rachel-sales: Customer asked for ETA and a mitigation now. Please coordinate rollback and message by EOD.

maria-eng-oncall: I'll run the rollback playbook now and monitor. `./playbooks/rollback.sh canary-2026-07-18-3` — posting logs here when done.

ops-bot: deploy-rollback started by maria-eng-oncall at 1767200120. tracking id: roll-8765

maria-eng-oncall: rollback completed at 1767200250. BeaconHealth p95 dropped to ~420ms within 3 minutes. Monitoring shows stable since 15:29 UTC. :thumbsup:

tina-support: Customer updated: much better, they see normal perf. They're still asking for root cause and prevention plan.

sam-prod: Next steps for product roadmap: 1) quick spec for per-route burst capacity (must include acceptance criteria), 2) prioritize cache/batching improvements from Q3 backlog, 3) define SLA rollback playbook in runbook.

eli-eng-platform: Draft spec idea: "Per-route burst window" — allow temporary extra concurrency for routes that exceed SLO, capped by pool budget. Acceptance: simulated load test reproduces spike and demonstrates auto-burst reduces p95 <500ms without impacting other tenants. Docs + console UI to opt-in.

sam-prod: Good. Also capture launch criteria: monitoring alert to validate behavior, e2e tests in CI, and a canary rollout with automatic rollback if cross-tenant p95 increases >10%.

jin-runtime: Scope note: auto-burst interacts with batching/caching heuristics — need to ensure KV cache warmup won't defeat benefits. Recommend separate spike mitigation MVP that doesn't rely on cache tuning.

rachel-sales: Please add the spec to product backlog and tag as customer-driven (BeaconHealth). They need a delivery window to discuss renewal.

sam-prod: I'll create PROD-6120 in the roadmap board with the spec outline and link SUP-4532 + INC-3421. Tentative priority: P0 for Q3 backlog review. Assigning to @eli-eng-platform for initial design, @jin-runtime for runtime implications.

tina-support: Marking SUP-4532 resolved for now, leaving follow-up tasks in PROD-6120. Customer will be notified.

maria-eng-oncall: Also propose adding an automated smoke test that runs post-deploy to detect the reduced-concurrency regression earlier.

eli-eng-platform: Agreed — adding test to CI is low-effort and high-value. Will queue a PR after PROD-6120 is fleshed out.

sam-prod: Thanks everyone. Action items: rollback done (maria), create PROD-6120 (sam), design doc draft for per-route burst (eli), runtime impact analysis (jin), CI smoke test (eli). ETA for initial design: 5 business days. We'll sync in roadmap review. :calendar:

rachel-sales: Thanks team — I'll let BeaconHealth know and loop legal if they request SLA language changes.

ops-bot: thread closed for incident after rollback verification at 1767200800.
